Players measure, stir, and bake using interactive kitchen tools to perfect each batch under time constraints. The game blends dessert preparation mechanics with classroom-style progression to refine your baking expertise.

Key Features

• Ingredient measurement mechanics  
• Interactive kitchen utensil controls  
• Time-based baking challenges  
• Multi-step recipe progression  
• Dessert-themed cooking environment

pages.title: Cooking Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Prepare and serve dishes by quickly combining ingredients in a timed cooking challenge that tests your speed and precision. The game’s core mechanic involves drag-and-drop ingredient assembly under time pressure, pushing players to optimize their actions to satisfy judges. As you progress, the complexity of recipes increases, requiring sharper multitasking skills and faster decision-making.

Key Features

• Drag-and-drop cooking mechanic  
• Time-limited recipe completion  
• Increasing recipe complexity  
• Multitask under pressure system  
• Casual kitchen contest setting

pages.title: Cooking After Workout
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Prepare balanced meals using ingredient combination mechanics to refuel characters after intense workout sessions. The game challenges players to quickly select and assemble nutrient-rich recipes, rewarding speed and accuracy. Players progress through levels with increasing ingredient variety and nutritional goals, emphasizing timed ingredient selection and basic cooking procedures.

Key Features

• Ingredient combination mechanic  
• Timed recipe assembly controls  
• Level progression with increasing complexity  
• Nutritional value scoring system  
• Casual cooking workout theme

pages.title: Annie Cooking Donuts
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Cook donuts by managing a virtual kitchen where timing and ingredient combinations shape successful recipes. Players prepare various flavored donuts using tap and drag controls to mix ingredients and operate cooking appliances. Progress unlocks new donut types and kitchen upgrades, creating a casual cooking experience focused on recipe precision and resource management.

Key Features

• Ingredient mixing timing mechanic  
• Tap and drag cooking controls  
• Recipe unlock progression system  
• Kitchen equipment upgrade paths  
• Casual food preparation theme

pages.title: Cindy Cooking Cupcakes
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Mix and decorate cupcakes by selecting ingredients and applying frosting layers in this charming baking game. Players experiment with various toppings and colors to create visually appealing cupcakes to impress virtual customers. The core mechanic revolves around ingredient combination and timed decoration challenges that test player precision and creativity.

Key Features

• Ingredient selection and mixing  
• Precise frosting application control  
• Timed decoration stages  
• Customer satisfaction scoring  
• Colorful bakery shop setting
